questions.question:
f(x) = 7x + 3
The function f gives the estimated height, in feet, of a willow tree x years after its height was first measured. Which statement is the best interpretation of 3 in this context?
options: The tree will be measured each year for 3 years.
The tree is estimated to grow to a maximum height of 3 feet.
The estimated height of the tree increased by 3 feet each year.
The estimated height of the tree was 3 feet when it was first measured.
questions.explanation: f(0) = 3, so 3 is the estimated height at the first measurement.

questions.question: If 16x + 5 = 8, what is the value of 6x?

y > 97x + b
In the given inequality, b is a positive constant. Which of the following does NOT contain any points (x, y) in the xy−plane that are solutions to this inequality?
options: The region where x < 0 and y < 0
The region where x < 0 and y > 0
The region where x > 0 and y > 0
The region where x > 0 and y < 0
questions.explanation: When x > 0 the right side (9/7)x + b is positive, so y would have to be greater than a positive number. No point with x > 0 and y < 0 can satisfy this.

y = 7

questions.question: A landscaping company mixes oil with gasoline to power its tools. A chainsaw requires 8 ounces of oil per gallon of gasoline. A lawnmower requires 4 ounces of oil per gallon of gasoline. The company uses a total of 21 ounces of oil in its mixes for the chainsaw and lawnmower. Which of the following equations represents this situation, where x represents the amount of gasoline, in gallons, in the mix for the chainsaw and y represents the amount of gasoline, in gallons, in the mix for the lawnmower?
The population of a certain city doubled every 75 years from 1651 to 1951. The population of this city was 160,000 in 1951. What was the population of this city in 1651?
questions.explanation: From 1651 to 1951 is 300 years, or 4 doublings, so the 1651 population was 160,000 / 2^4 = 10,000.

questions.question:
−3x2 − 7x + 1 = 0
What is the greatest solution to the given equation?
questions.explanation: Rewrite as 3x² + 7x − 1 = 0. The quadratic formula gives x = (−7 ± √61)/6; the greater is −7/6 + √61/6.

questions.question: The function g is a quadratic function. In the xy-plane, the graph of y = g(x) has a vertex at (−1, −4) and passes through the points (−2, −43) and (1, −160). What is the value of g(0) − g(2)?
The function f is defined by f(x) = x<sup>2</sup> + x + 61. What is the value of f(2)?

The function f(x) = 242(1.040)<sup>x</sup> models the value, in dollars, of a certain bank account from 1953 through 1968, where x is the number of years after the end of 1953. Which of the following is the best interpretation of "f(5) is approximately equal to 294" in this context?
options: The value of the bank account is estimated to be approximately 5 dollars greater at the end of 1958 than at the end of 1953.
The value of the bank account is estimated to be approximately 294 dollars at the end of 1958.
The value, in dollars, of the bank account is estimated to be approximately 5 times greater at the end of 1958 than at the end of 1953.
The value of the bank account is estimated to increase by approximately 294 dollars every 5 years between the end of 1953 and the end of 1968.
questions.explanation: x = 5 is the end of 1958, and f(5) is the account value in dollars.

questions.question:
y = 3((a)/(6))(x+c) − b
How many times does the graph of the given equation in the xy−plane cross the x−axis, where a, b, and c are positive constants such that a > 6 and b > c?
questions.explanation: Since a/6 > 1 this is an increasing exponential whose values range over all numbers greater than −b, and −b is negative, so the graph crosses the x-axis exactly once.

questions.question:
x2 + (√(k − 3))x + 42 = 0
In the given equation, k is a constant. The equation has exactly one real solution. What is the value of k?
questions.explanation: Exactly one solution means the discriminant is 0: (k − 3) − 4(42) = 0, so k − 3 = 168 and k = 171.

questions.question: The price of an object increased from $16 to $80. What was the percent increase in the price of the object?
questions.explanation: The increase is 80 − 16 = 64, and 64 ÷ 16 = 4 = 400%.

questions.question: A jar has 430 marbles, and 20% of these marbles are blue. How many marbles in the jar are blue?

For each of two rectangles, the ratio of the rectangle’s length to its width is 10 to 5. The width of rectangle X is 16.5 times the width of rectangle Y . How does the length of rectangle X compare to the length of rectangle Y ?
options: The length of rectangle X is 0.5 times the length of rectangle Y .
The length of rectangle X is 2 times the length of rectangle Y .
The length of rectangle X is 16.5 times the length of rectangle Y .
The length of rectangle X is 33 times the length of rectangle Y .

A hemisphere is half of a sphere. If a hemisphere has a radius of 50 inches, which of the following is closest to the volume, in cubic inches, of this hemisphere?

A partially filled container containing 24 milliliters of water is placed under a leaky faucet that produces one 0.08-milliliter drop of water every 8 seconds. Until the container is full, which of the following can be used to represent the volume v, in milliliters, of water in the container t seconds after it is placed under the faucet, where t is a multiple of 8?
questions.explanation: The faucet adds 0.08 mL every 8 seconds, which is 0.01 mL per second, so v = 0.01t + 24.

questions.question: Right rectangular prism X is similar to right rectangular prism Y. The surface area of right rectangular prism X is 59 square centimeters (cm<sup>2</sup>), and the surface area of right rectangular prism Y is 1,475 cm<sup>2</sup>. The volume of right rectangular prism Y is 1,500 cubic centimeters (cm<sup>3</sup>). What is the sum of the volumes, in cm<sup>3</sup>, of right rectangular prism X and right rectangular prism Y?
questions.explanation: The surface-area ratio is 59/1475 = 1/25, so the scale factor is 1/5 and the volume ratio is 1/125. Prism X has volume 1500/125 = 12, so the sum is 12 + 1500 = 1512.

questions.question: Line t in the xy−plane has a slope of 18 and passes through the point (32, −7). Which equation defines line t?
questions.explanation: With slope 1/8, y = x/8 + b. Substituting (32, −7) gives −7 = 4 + b, so b = −11.

questions.question: If x + 1 = 3, what is the value of 2(x + 1)?
questions.explanation: Substitute x + 1 = 3: 2(3) = 6.

questions.question: If 2x + 3 = 9, what is the value of 4x − 4?
questions.explanation: 2x = 6, so x = 3 and 4x − 4 = 8.

questions.question: The graph models the number of active projects a company was working on x months after the end of November 2011, where 0 ≤ x ≤ 6. According to the model, what is the predicted number of active projects the company was working on at the end of November 2011?
questions.explanation: The end of November 2011 is x = 0, where the graph is at 8.

questions.question: In the figure shown, line k intersects lines r and s. If w = 141, which additional piece of information is sufficient to prove that lines r and s are parallel?
questions.explanation: Angles w and y are corresponding angles; if y = 141 = w, the corresponding angles are congruent, so r and s are parallel. x = 39 follows from w anyway and says nothing about s.

questions.question: A student needs at least 190 signatures from classmates to run for class president. The student collects 30 signatures on Monday and collects enough additional signatures on Tuesday to run for class president. Which inequality represents the number of additional signatures, s, that the student collects on Tuesday?
questions.explanation: "At least 190" means s + 30 ≥ 190.

questions.question: A freight elevator can hold a maximum weight of 5,340 pounds during one trip. A 190-pound person needs to deliver several boxes using the freight elevator. Some of these boxes weigh 25 pounds each and the others weigh 64 pounds each. Which inequality represents the possible combinations of the number of 25-pound boxes, x, and the number of 64-pound boxes, y, the person can deliver during one trip if only the person and the boxes are on the freight elevator?
questions.explanation: The total weight 190 + 25x + 64y must be at most 5,340, so 25x + 64y ≤ 5,150.

questions.question: p = √12c − 25. The given equation relates the variables p and c, where c is positive. Which equation correctly expresses c in terms of p?

The function P(x) = 533(1.011)<sup>x</sup> models the population of a certain town each year from 1951 through 1966, where x is the number of years after 1951. Which of the following is the best interpretation of "P(5) is approximately equal to 563" in this context?
options: The population of the town is estimated to be approximately 5 greater in 1956 than in 1951.
The population of the town is estimated to be approximately 563 in 1956.
The population of the town is estimated to be approximately 5 times greater in 1956 than in 1951.
The population of the town is estimated to increase by approximately 563 every 5 years between 1951 and 1966.
questions.explanation: x = 5 is 5 years after 1951, which is 1956, and P(5) is the population then.

x(9x − 2a) + b(9x − 2a) − (x + b) = 0
In the given equation, a and b are positive constants. A solution to the equation is x = 42. What is the value of a?
questions.explanation: The left side factors as (x + b)(9x − 2a − 1) = 0. Since b is positive, x = −b is negative, so the solution 42 comes from 9x − 2a − 1 = 0. Then 378 − 2a − 1 = 0, so a = 377/2.

Julia purchased 800 feet of fencing. She used 60% of this fencing to surround a vegetable garden. How many feet of fencing did Julia use to surround the vegetable garden?
Julia purchased 600 feet of fencing. She used 70% of this fencing to surround a vegetable garden. How many feet of fencing did Julia use to surround the vegetable garden?

The Mars Perseverance rover is a robot designed to collect samples of rock and soil. During an experiment, the rover moves at a constant speed on a straight path toward a designated target. The equation y = 390 − 142x gives the rover’s remaining distance from its target y, in meters, x hours after the start of the experiment. What is the best interpretation of 390 in this context?
options: The number of hours it takes the rover to reach its target
The rover’s speed, in meters per hour, during the experiment
The rover’s distance, in meters, from its target at the start of the experiment
The total distance, in meters, the rover travels in 1 hour
questions.explanation: At x = 0, y = 390, so 390 is the distance from the target at the start.

questions.question: The mass of object A is 481% of the mass of object B, and the mass of object A is 0.074% of the mass of object C. If the mass of object C is p% of the mass of object B, what is the value of p1,000?
What is the value of tan(50π3)?
questions.explanation: 50π/3 = 16π + 2π/3, and tan has period π, so tan(50π/3) = tan(2π/3) = −√3.

questions.question: In triangle QRS, what is the value of tan y°?
questions.explanation: In right triangle QRS, tan y° = opposite/adjacent = QR/RS = 4/9.

questions.question: An object's speed is increasing at a rate of 1.1 meters per second squared. What is this rate, in <u>miles per minute squared</u>, rounded to the nearest tenth? (Use 1 mile = 1,609 meters.)
questions.explanation: 1.1 m/s^2 × 3,600 s^2/min^2 = 3,960 m/min^2, and 3,960 ÷ 1,609 ≈ 2.5 miles per minute squared.

questions.question: A triangular prism has a height of 9 centimeters (cm) and a volume of 234 cm<sup>3</sup>. What is the area, in cm<sup>2</sup>, of the base of the prism? (The volume of a triangular prism is equal to Bh, where B is the area of the base and h is the height of the prism.)

In triangle ABC and triangle DEF, sides AB and DE each have a side length of 6 inches, and angles A and D each have an angle measure of 40°. Which of the following additional pieces of information is(are) sufficient to prove whether triangle ABC is congruent to triangle DEF?
I. The measures of angles B and C are equal.
II. The lengths of sides AC and DF are equal.
III. The lengths of sides BC and EF are equal.
options: I is sufficient, but II and III are not.
II is sufficient, but I and III are not.
III is sufficient, but I and II are not.
II is sufficient and III is sufficient, but I is not.
questions.explanation: II gives side-angle-side, which proves congruence. I only says triangle ABC is isosceles and says nothing about DEF. III gives side-side-angle, which is not enough.
